title: 注文の多い料理店 (Chūmon no Ōi Ryōriten — The Restaurant of Many Orders) — 宮沢賢治
description: Two pompous hunters get lost in the mountains, where their expensive dogs die of fright. They stumble upon an elegant western restaurant — 'WILDCAT HOUSE' — that welcomes them warmly with a series of increasingly suspicious instructions: tidy your hair, leave your weapons, remove your overcoats and hats, rub cream all over your body, sprinkle yourself with salt… A darkly comic fable about greed and hubris. First published December 1, 1924. (~4,800 characters)
